tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List Workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces in the Anthropic organization, with cursor pagination. The Default Workspace is never included in results.

after_id.description: Cursor. Return the page immediately after this object ID (the previous response's last_id).

before_id.description: Cursor. Return the page immediately before this object ID (the previous response's first_id).

include_archived.description: Include archived workspaces in the results. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.title: List API Keys
tools.description: List the organization's API keys with their status, workspace, creator and expiry. Key values are never returned. Supports cursor pagination and filtering by status, workspace or creator.

after_id.description: Cursor. Return the page immediately after this object ID (the previous response's last_id).

before_id.description: Cursor. Return the page immediately before this object ID (the previous response's first_id).

created_by_user_id.description: ID of the organization member (prefixed `user_`). Filters to keys this member created.

limit.description: Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 20.

status.description: Filter to keys in this status.

workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace (prefixed `wrkspc_`). Filters to keys scoped to this workspace.
